title: Quantum Measurement? ... MEH
summary: We formulate a residual-and-information framework for continuous quantum measurement in which non-Markovian record history is represented by an exact anchored accumulation and conditional measurement ambiguity is represented by a residual whose zero set is the extremal record manifold. The construction is deliberately layered on established quantum instruments, nondemolition filtering, and quantum-trajectory theory rather than presented as a replacement for them.
